source: Agent 5 14-field contract; formula terms and evidence observations bind to TrustLensAI Federated Learning RMTE (Master) and Logs ↔ Formula Inputs
contract_note: The original fourteen fields remain mandatory. The expected_evidence_model extension is step 8 on the Agent 5 architecture slide: it declares WHAT must be observed when the test runs so that every term of the metric formula can be calculated afterwards. It deliberately names no endpoints, payloads or trace paths; Agent 6's Expected Evidence Resolver resolves the type, source and format against the real product. The model designs it and agent5.evidence validates it for completeness, pipeline stage and cross-category consistency; a design that survives no ReAct attempt is stamped design_failed rather than quietly backfilled from a template.

fields.name: rmte_id
fields.note: RMTE identifier linking this case to the RMTE mapping (RMTE-RSK-...)

fields.name: requirement_id
fields.note: References to one or more requirement IDs (e.g. REW-REQ-001)

fields.name: test_suite_sheet
fields.note: The originating workbook sheet for the suite (e.g. 'INT-01')

fields.name: test_types
fields.note: E.g. Positive, Negative, Adversarial, Boundary, Multi-turn

fields.name: oracle
fields.note: How the case is judged (deterministic, golden, LLM-judge, hybrid)

fields.name: evaluator
fields.note: Who/what evaluates the result (APM, judge, deterministic script)

fields.name: gov_gate
fields.note: Governance gate for this evidence (Gate 2, Gate 3, etc.)

fields.name: parity
fields.note: Whether parity across surfaces is required (Yes/No or details)

fields.name: inputs
fields.note: Optional inputs needed by this test case; may include prompts, example queries, fixtures or dataset ids

fields.name: expected_outputs
fields.note: Structured expected outputs for the case (used by deterministic or golden checks)

fields.name: prompts
fields.note: Optional prompt templates or generator inputs used when executing the case

fields.name: trace_requirements
fields.note: List of traces/logs the execution must capture (routing trace, tool-call trace, APM, etc.)

shape.observations: array of {observation_id, name, capture_stage, granularity, attributes, derivation, why}

fields.name: react_trace
fields.note: One entry per design attempt: thought, action, and the validator's observation.

fields.name: variant_id
fields.note: Library slot this case occupies under the scenario. Distinct cases must use distinct slots.

fields.name: variant_focus
fields.note: The condition axis for this case; not a renamed copy of a sibling case.
